Passionate about web and mobile development, I enjoy designing modern applications that are useful and tailored to users' needs. I am particularly interested in Frontend and Backend development, as well as building innovative software solutions.

jobs.title: Final Year Project Internship
jobs.subtitle: SmartService – Platform Connecting Clients and Service Providers
jobs.description: Led the development of a full-stack mobile platform connecting clients and service providers. Technologies: Spring Boot, Flutter, MySQL, JWT, Spring Security, WebSocket, Firebase Cloud Messaging, Google Maps.
achievements: Developed the backend with Spring Boot and a REST API consumed by the mobile app.
Built a cross-platform mobile application with Flutter.
Implemented secure authentication using JWT and Spring Security.
Developed a matching system connecting clients with service providers.
Delivered key features: booking system, real-time chat (WebSocket) and live GPS tracking.
Integrated Google Maps for geolocation, navigation and real-time provider tracking.
Integrated push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Built an admin dashboard to manage users and validate providers.
Performed client review sentiment analysis using an AI model (XLM-RoBERTa).

Delivered dashboards for employees and HR managers.
Managed leave requests and status tracking with notifications.
